2b:Tbbe,/**
 * Theme —— 深色 / 浅色两套主题并排
 *
 * 两栏里是**同一段结构、同一批类名**，唯一差别是根元素上的 data-theme：
 *   左栏不写 data-theme  → 走 :root 的深色（默认）
 *   右栏 data-theme="light" → 命中浅色重绑块
 *
 * 所以这一屏同时也是「组件层零改动」的证据：切主题只换了第 2 层的值，
 * components.css / pages.css 一行都没动。
 *
 * 右侧那栏用的是**产品自己的属性选择器**，不是文档站造的第二套映射 ——
 * [data-theme="light"] 挂在哪个元素上就在哪个子树生效，所以能这样局部演示。
 */

function Panel({ label, theme }: { label: string; theme?: "light" }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="pb-preview"
      data-theme={theme}
      style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, padding: 16, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 12 }}
    >
      <span className="pb-spec">{label}</span>

      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-head">
          <span className="dot is-on" />
          <span className="card-name">客户件量分析 2026</span>
          <span className="tag">vue-scaffold</span>
          <span className="port-chip">:5173</span>
        </div>
        <div className="card-meta">/Users/jerry/WorkBuddy/customer-volume-analysis</div>
        <div className="card-ops">
          <button className="btn is-ghost">停止</button>
          <button className="btn is-ghost">浏览器</button>
          <button className="btn is-ghost push-end">删除</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="pb-row">
        <button className="btn">普通</button>
        <button className="btn is-primary">主要</button>
        <button className="btn is-danger">危险</button>
      </div>

      <div className="pb-row">
        <button className="chip is-on">dist</button>
        <button className="chip">out</button>
        <button className="chip">.next</button>
      </div>

      <input className="input" placeholder="搜索端口 / 进程…" readOnly />

      <div className="pb-row">
        <span className="pl-badge is-warn">剩余 4 分钟</span>
        <span className="pl-badge is-perm">长期有效</span>
        <span className="pl-badge is-dead">已过期</span>
        <span className="pl-badge">剩余 33 分钟</span>
      </div>

      <div className="pl-item">
        <div className="pl-top">
          <span className="pl-proj">PortButler 文档站</span>
          <span className="pl-badge">剩余 33 分钟</span>
        </div>
        <div className="pl-url">https://hello-world-a1b2c3.pages.dev</div>
        <div className="pl-meta">09-17 21:52 · 8 分钟前 · out</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Demo() {
  return (
    <div className="pb-row-start" style={{ width: "100%", flexWrap: "nowrap" }}>
      <Panel label=":root · 深色（默认）" />
      <Panel label='[data-theme="light"] · 浅色' theme="light" />
    </div>
  );
